extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Flower structure — a flower has four main parts: sepals (small green leaves that protect the bud), petals (colorful leaves that attract insects), androecium/stamen (MALE part: anther produces pollen, filament supports anther), gynoecium/pistil (FEMALE part: stigma catches pollen, style connects stigma to ovary, ovary contains ovules). (2) Pollination — transfer of pollen grains from the anther (male) to the stigma (female). Self-pollination: pollen transfers within the same flower. Cross-pollination: pollen transfers to a different flower (by insects, wind, water). (3) Sexual reproduction — after pollination, pollen travels down the style to the ovary. Male cell joins with female ovule (fertilization). Ovule develops into a seed. Ovary develops into a fruit. Seed grows into a new plant. (4) Seed dispersal — seeds spread to new places to avoid competition. Wind: dandelion, maple (light seeds with wings/hair). Water: coconut, lotus (seeds that float). Animals: burrs stick to fur, birds eat fruits and drop seeds. Explosion: seed pods burst open (pea, bean). (5) Vegetative reproduction — new plants grow from vegetative parts (no seeds needed). Stem: potato, ginger (underground stems). Root: sweet potato, carrot. Leaf: bryophyllum (baby plants on leaf edges). Bulb: onion, garlic. Advantages: faster than seeds, exact copy of parent plant. Misconceptions: 'pollination and fertilization are the same' (WRONG — pollination is pollen reaching stigma; fertilization is male and female cells joining inside the ovary, which happens AFTER pollination), 'all seeds are dispersed by wind' (WRONG — seeds use many methods: wind, water, animals, explosion), 'vegetative reproduction produces different plants from the parent' (WRONG — vegetative reproduction produces exact copies/clones of the parent plant), 'the fruit develops from the seed' (WRONG — the fruit develops from the OVARY, and the seed develops from the OVULE), 'flowers are only for decoration' (WRONG — flowers are the reproductive organs of plants).
